note: GPTQ-lite re-quantisation of the pinned bf16 head (EigenLabs/Qwen3.8-27B-MTP-bf16) to 4-bit affine group-64, calibrated on 3456 real head-input (post-norm hidden, next-token-id) pairs captured from local MTP decode on the frontier tree. The 8 2D Linear weights become packed U32 weights plus bf16 scales/biases (31 tensors); the 7 1D norms stay bf16. Per-group least-squares scales fit to the activation-weighted error with beta = group min (MLX affine convention), so every scale is positive -- unlike the previous 4-bit head, which carries ~50% sign-flipped groups. On the same local fixture the two heads score identically (2.44-2.53 at 128 tokens, 0.9821 acceptance), but offline argmax comparison over the compact draft vocabulary shows this head preserves the exact bf16 head's top-1 in its top-2 on 78.4% of drafts vs 70.2% for the previous head, and 70.4% vs 58.6% on small-margin (risky) drafts, with a materially more faithful top-2 margin signal (corr 0.728 vs 0.604) that the schedule's confidence gates consume. The head only proposes; the pinned target re-verifies every emitted token against the hidden serial trajectory.
